rule: Each bundle's gate is fixed here before its first run. A bundle that misses a gate is fixed and rerun as a new frozen version; thresholds are never changed after results are seen. Every deviation is recorded in the ledger's plan-and-deviations field and in an amendment file next to this one.

splits.design: dev splits of plans/splits.json (CausalArena semantic and formula, 25 scenarios each)
held_out: test splits of plans/splits.json (25 per family), scored once per frozen kernel version
Causal Chambers light tunnel (physical truth, real interventions)

controls.names: real / neutral / swapped where names are read
controls.scoring: directed F1 under the expectation rule (undecided pairs at random, per-file seed); DV-1 committed-claim precision and coverage; both stated with every number

B0.test: engine oracle check on 120 random DAGs x 6 column orders
supplier fault-injection suite: missing key, truncation (finish_reason=length), invalid JSON, code-fenced JSON, empty reply, HTTP 429 storm, quota refusal
B0.pass: every case completes; each failure and each accepted normalisation is counted in the ledger; claims on affected pairs equal the data-only output

B1.test: invariants I1-I4 and I7 on every dev file (semantic, formula)
held-out (test splits): directed F1 and DV-1 precision of the data-only kernel against plain causal-learn PC with maxP, paired by file
B1.pass: mean difference >= -0.01 on both metrics in both families

B1.test: verifier V1-V8 on every emitted ledger
B1.pass: every ledger accepted; mutation tests reject a ledger with one evidence record removed

B2.test: DV-1 precision on CausalArena D+I test files and Causal Chambers
B2.pass: >= B1 on the same files (paired mean difference >= 0)

B3.test: I3 and I5 on every held-out file and arm
B3.pass: neutral arm output == D output; skeleton identical to D in every arm

B3.test: swapped-arm loss against the data-only output
B3.pass: within the T3 bound in 100% of files
never below B1 by more than 0.01 on any family mean (reported: the gain)

B4.test: within-family calibration error on held-out scenarios (map fitted on dev, frozen)
claimed vs realised precision of the selective view at c/g = 1, 2, 4

B5.test: adapters for Causal-Copilot stages, MATMCD, Vashishtha, PyWhy-LLM, causaliq on the AB-06 outputs
B5.pass: every flagged violation traced to a claim and a source; 0 'unknown' sources where the agent records provenance

B5.test: PetShop held-out with declared topology and abstention
B5.pass: AC@3 at stated coverage reported against learned-graph RCA (no threshold: descriptive)

order: strict: B0 -> B1 -> B2/B3 -> B4 -> B5; a bundle builds only on predecessors that passed
